subtasks.title: Child-side dynamic prompt mechanism + capability probe + degrade
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE (CRITICAL — overrides PRD prose): realtimestt_internals.md: installed RealtimeSTT 1.0.2 confirmed. initial_prompt (finals) is baked into TranscriptionEngineConfig in the WORKER SUBPROCESS at worker start (installed core/transcription.py:93-107); the worker pipe protocol (audio, language, use_prompt) carries no prompt updates. initial_prompt_realtime is live-pokable ONLY via recorder.realtime_transcription_model.config.initial_prompt (base.py:163-166 reads per call) — but our single-model construction (use_main_model_for_realtime=True, from P1.M1.T2.S2) routes realtime through that SAME worker, so NEITHER plain attribute poke works. recorder_host.py seams: child command loop :549-554 (blocks in text(); the _abort_handler side-thread :517-524 is the pattern for a prompt watcher); build_recorder :458-478.
2. INPUT: P1.M1.T1.S1 cfg.asr.context_prompt flag; P1.M1.T2.S2 single-mode child (build_recorder signature without lite).
3. LOGIC: Add ('prompt', {'text': str}) to the child's cmd_q handling, applied between utterances (mirror the _abort_handler watcher-thread pattern if the main loop is blocked in text()). Dynamic mechanism, in preference order: (a) a fork-inherited shared value (multiprocessing.Array ~2 KB) + a monkeypatch applied in the child BEFORE AudioToTextRecorder construction that wraps the worker-side engine's transcribe (installed transcription_engines/base.py — prompt is read from self.config per call) to read from the shared value; Linux fork start method carries both the patch and the shared value into the worker process. (b) startup capability probe verifies the patch actually took effect (e.g. a sentinel round-trip or engine-config inspection); if the probe FAILS: degrade to context-free decoding and log ONCE — never crash, never wedge the child. Gate everything on cfg.asr.context_prompt (false = never patch, never ship). Report dynamic-vs-degraded status to the daemon via evt_q (new event, e.g. ('prompt_mode', {'dynamic': bool})). Unit tests with a fake recorder (copy tests/test_recorder_host.py patterns): prompt command applied to the poke seam, degrade path logs once and keeps decoding, context_prompt=false disables entirely. No CUDA loads in unit tests (monkeypatch build_recorder).
4. OUTPUT: recorder_host applies a prompt string to BOTH partial and final decodes when dynamic mode is active, else degrades+logs; consumed by P1.M2.T5.S2 (daemon ships prompts) and asserted by P1.M3.T8.S1 (assert d).
5. DOCS: none beyond code comments/docstrings — config.toml context_prompt comment already landed in P1.M1.T1.S1.
